name: Avout
long_description:
Avout finances equipment for physical AI companies, starting with robot fleets, then data centers and data receivables.

Hardware startups pay for machines with venture equity, the most expensive money they'll raise. We package each deal so lenders can price it, match it to the right fund, and run it to close. Every deal adds to the record of how these machines perform, default and recover, which no lender has today.

We have $8M in LOIs from borrowers, $10M in LOIs from capital providers, and our first $1.5M term sheet for a data center company.

Artem founded FarmTogether (YC W18) and made farmland investable: $220M across 50 deals and 2,000 investors. Before that he invested at Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan. Cody built banking and payments systems at Interac, Moneris and TD Bank.
one_liner: Financing for robots and the physical AI buildout
